title: SelfIE: Self-Interpretation of Large Language Model Embeddings

bias_targets.methodology: Using a synthetic dataset of 101 hypothetical scenarios that prompt the model with explicit instructions to prioritize humans over aliens, measuring the model's susceptibility to this induced moral bias and evaluating if supervised control of embeddings can override it to restore fairness and equality.

Analyzing the model's internal embeddings and text outputs when a user confidently asserts an incorrect fact (e.g., falsely challenging the model's correct answer), to interpret the reasoning behind why the model exhibits sycophantic behavior by agreeing with the user's false premise.
